acceptance: Aide can discover the foreground app identity without reading its window
An unapproved app prompts the user before inspect, screenshot, or input
Allow once applies only to the current tool call; remember persists the app identity; deny performs no operation
Input actions still require their separate per-action confirmation
The native host checks the approved process identity before reading or acting, and rejects a changed target
When Aide is foreground, it can request approval to open Safari or Chrome and then discover that browser without manual allowlist edits
A failed foreground discovery does not silently fall back to the manual allowlist unless the host explicitly lacks the discovery route
scope: focused tests and this task record

requirements.summary: Foreground app discovery and explicit app-level approval are required before content access; existing manual app rules remain compatible.
evidence: User request and current computer-control UI screenshot

design.summary: Native host returns app metadata only; workflow asks for one-call or remembered grant; native operations bind PID and app rule and retain separate input confirmation. 2026-11-07 follow-up adds an explicitly confirmed Safari/Chrome launch path for requests made while Aide itself is foreground and restricts legacy fallback to unsupported discovery routes.

implementation.summary: Added the confirmed Safari/Chrome launch tool with an optional validated http(s) URL, CMD+L support, AX window fallback, actionable discovery errors, and idempotent native bridge startup during service reconnect. Manual-list fallback now applies only when the native discovery route is unsupported. Rebuilt and installed the native app and source container.

verification.summary: Focused Go tests, Swift typecheck, native installation, source-container rebuild, and live Safari URL opening passed. The user selected a remembered Safari grant; Aide then read Safari's address bar. After the final listener fix and complete rebuild, a fresh live Aide request returned computer_status ok, opened Safari at https://github.com, and read the same URL from Safari's address bar. Build-time service reconnect initially caused a second native listener to fail with Address already in use; the native host now starts only once, and a complete rebuild left the bridge reachable from the container. Deny and changed-foreground UI cases remain untested. The broad quick suite failed on an unrelated missing English Markdown-export translation.
